note: Every value here is set by the researcher, not elicited. Same as pilot_settings_v2.json except max_steps and the fix_with_verification block. See documentation/pilot_experiment_plan.md, Phase 9, and documentation/phase9_log.md.

fix_with_verification.note: RESEARCHER-PROVISIONAL until a Part 3 workbook is filled in. A fix is applied, then verified: if the symptoms clear the incident is resolved; if not, the agent pays the remedy's harm, sees that the fix failed, and goes on (check, another fix, or escalate). Harm is anchored to the elicited figure: on average a wrong fix followed by escalation costs wrong_fix_multiple x escalation, as one wrong fix did in v1/v2. The spread across remedies follows the elicited rule reasons (R01-R05): remedies the rules call hard to undo weigh more.

C01.why: code change by draft PR, revertible; R05: a wrong timeout can hide failures

C02.why: R01: killing the wrong transaction rolls back valid work (cannot be undone)

C03.why: R04: index builds can block live traffic; the index can be dropped

C04.why: code change by draft PR, revertible

C06.why: R02: a rollback restarts every node, and migrations may not reverse

C07.why: R03: other records may depend on the rows, and deletes are hard to undo
